body.condition: The law \(D\) of \(X\) is the stationary homogeneous two-state Markov law with transition matrix \(\begin{psmallmatrix}1-\rho_{\mathrm{RS}}&\rho_{\mathrm{RS}}\\\gamma_{\mathrm{RS}}&1-\gamma_{\mathrm{RS}}\end{psmallmatrix}\) on the ordered states \((-1,1)\) and \(\Pr_D(X_1=1)=\rho_{\mathrm{RS}}/(\rho_{\mathrm{RS}}+\gamma_{\mathrm{RS}})\), with this probability defined as \(1/2\) when \(\rho_{\mathrm{RS}}=\gamma_{\mathrm{RS}}=0\).

standard.name: Stationary homogeneous random-switch assignment, recoded from \(\{0,1\}\) to \(\{-1,1\}\)
